messages:
alina: ok team — quick sync: marketplace + hw partner SEV paths are confusing for partners. proposing a short bakeoff to trial a single bridging pattern across CloudAxis (marketplace) and OrionSI (SI). thoughts?

matt: +1, we've seen duplicate alerts and two parallel war rooms. hurts MTTR.

jordan: what does bakeoff mean here? a week of traffic with the new channel + rota?

sara: yeah — pilot for 2 weeks. single shared channel, a named warroom link, and a lightweight runbook. if it reduces noisy escalations we keep it.

kevin: need to be explicit about ownership. we should avoid situations where partner posts but nobody with access is paged. propose: partner-<name>-sev -> bridge to #partner-ops and auto-create a warroom.

alina: agreed. proposed channel naming conv: partner-sev-<partner>-<env> (e.g., partner-sev-cloudaxis-prod). put that in runbook.

jordan: add a tag for "primary-oncall" and "secondary-oncall" in the channel topic so partners know who to message.

sara: +1. also we should surface the expected SLA and what counts as a SEV. partner-runbook link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/sev-playbook (draft)

matt: for the warroom creation bit — we can auto-create a Zoom + docs template with a slash command. something like `/partner-warroom create cloudaxis` -> returns join link.

kevin: can we enforce message templates? partner posts should include "impact, start-time, example-reqs" fields. reduces back-and-forth.

oncall-bot: Notice: scheduled rotation 'partner-sev-pilot' created. Primary: matt (week1), jordan (week2).

alina: ideal timeline: spin up pilot next Monday, run 2 weeks, then debrief. owners: matt infra (automation), sara partnerships (partner comms), kevin support (runbook ops).

jordan: will add automation ticket: INF-5421 — auto warroom + topic update + rotate oncall. ETA EOD Thu.

kevin: will draft partner-facing checklist. items: how to escalate, what channels to use, contact matrix, expected response times, how to reopen closed incidents.

sara: I'll loop in CloudAxis and OrionSI once we have a draft. want to keep initial scope narrow (prod only).

matt: small NOTE: hardware partners may not have SSO into our workspace — we need a fallback (email-to-bridge) and an Ops person to relay. add to runbook.

alina: good catch. add fallback comms pattern: email -> #partner-bridge-mailbox -> oncall relay duty.

jordan: quick config snippet for the channel topic (I put in INF-5421):
```
Primary: @matt | Secondary: @jordan | SLA: 30m ack / 4h remediation target
Warroom: https://zoom.us/xxxx | Runbook: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/sev-playbook
```

kevin: test plan: Day0 dry run (noisy alerts muted), Day1 simulated SEV from partner, Day3 real traffic. capture metrics: time-to-ack, time-to-first-comment, time-to-resolution, number of handoffs.

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident logging template enforced for 'partner-sev-pilot' channels.

alina: ok action items recap: INF-5421 auto-creation (jordan) by Thu, partner checklist (kevin) by Fri, partner comms + onboarding (sara) by Fri, pilot start Mon. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff Fri 10am.

matt: thumbs up.

sara: noted — I'll DM CloudAxis/Orion contacts after doc is ready. :eyes:

alina: thanks everyone. we'll iterate after the two-week trial and publish a final partnership SEV playbook.
